{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Uh oh''. Something tells me that's not the stewardess service.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], upon seeing [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]|<ref name="Drone Alone">{{SWComicCite|7.10|Drone Alone}}</ref>}}
A '''steward''' was a being who served aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] such as [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liners]]. They were responsible for the care of passengers aboard such ships.
